7d124921.text:
Oi, you, $c. Get off yer duff and come see me behind the abbey. A soft, green $c such as yerself canna hope to survive let alone thrive in this land without some guidance, and ol' Tordrin is here to provide it, if ye have the guts! 


Tordrin Stemblade, (extremely handsome) $C Trainer
7d124921.title: Scribbled Letter

10837|0aa55eb6.name: High Executor Derrington
10837|0aa55eb6.text:
Welcome to the front lines, $c.  While politicians may connive and scheme amongst themselves, they'll find no such luxury afforded to them here.  This is the Bulwark, and we fight for our continued survival on a daily basis here.

If you've come here looking for a chance to prove yourself as a hero, then you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so... especially as we push towards Andorhal and whatever malign force that controls the Scourge there.

11057|58398b91.name: Apothecary Dithers
11057|58398b91.text: A fierce wind is coming - I can tell by the ache in my exposed knee.  I just hope we don't get caught up in it.

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

11867|d85affd4.name: Woo Ping
11867|d85affd4.text:
Buliwyf, the dwarven weapon master at the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, teaches fist weapons, guns, one and two-handed axes and one and two-handed maces.

Bixi Wobblebonk, the gnome weapon master at the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, teaches crossbow, daggers and throwing weapons.

Ilyenia Moonfire, the night elf weapon master, resides at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus where she teaches bow, daggers, fist weapons, staff and throwing weapons.

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1632|fee38227.name: Adele Fielder
1632|fee38227.text: Since my husband left for the front, Helene here has been my strength. Her kind heart and sharp sword have helped me through a lot of tough times. I don't know what I would've done without her.

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

332-progress.name: Suzetta Gallina
332-progress.text: Greetings and welcome, master.  Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
332-progress.title: Wine Shop Advert

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

426-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless $r back into the Plaguelands!
426-progress.title: The Mills Overrun

492-progress.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-progress.text: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
492-progress.title: A New Plague

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

92479-accept.name: Marshal McBride
92479-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local $c trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479-accept.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-complete.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-complete.text:
Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled $c can give 'em. Good luck.
92479-complete.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-progress.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-progress.text:
Ah, ye got me letter, $N... good.

Time was when ye'd not catch a $r dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
92479-progress.title: A Scribbled Letter

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed
